evidence: Changes C++ standard to C++23 across CMakeLists.txt, depends, and CI setup scripts, bumping minimum compiler requirements to GCC 13 and Clang 19.
rationale: Raising the minimum compiler standard to C++23 across all build and CI environments is a strategic baseline change for the project. As noted by the author, 'workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating', and establishing compiler support enables modern standard library features while removing compatibility shims.
